hints.capitals: Look at the very first letter. C# cares about capital letters.
hints.spaces: + adds no spaces. The only space is the one inside "Hello, ".
hints.punctuation: Check the comma after Hello and the ! at the end.

tasks.title: Age in 10 years

hints.compile: Console.ReadLine() gives you text, but age is an int box. Wrap it: int.Parse(Console.ReadLine()). Count the brackets: there are two ) at the end.
hints.error: When you run it, type your age in digits, like 13, not in words.

hints.spaces: + adds no spaces. Put them inside the speech marks: " minutes is " and " seconds".
hints.compile: Read the number with int.Parse(Console.ReadLine()) and store it in an int box.
hints.other: Times the minutes by 60 to get the seconds. Print only the answer, with no question first.
hints.lines: Print just one line, and don't print a question before reading the number.
